scope: Non-dialogue prose audit, part 1. The PL rows of 02_items/03_skills/04_config_text/05_mission_text/07/08 names had never been language-reviewed (28,431 PL rows, 17,724 prose rows = 5,846 unique texts). Controlled-class scans found the prose clean; two systemic defects were fixed with one source-bound plan (config/pl/nondialogue-unit-data-sysmes-2026-10-26.json, 357 rows): (a) 348 weight/length rows of the unit-data panel still carried the ENGLISH column (Weight/Len./Empty Wt./Dry Weight) although the translated rows of the same field already use 'Masa 54,0 t'/'Dł. 25,0 m' - the panel was half translated, half English; now fully Polish per that convention, Polish decimal comma, Polish thousands spacing, fictional units (shin/zusshiri/mett/rufton) kept in romaji; (b) 9 sysmes rows: the save-failure prompts were still English ('Save failed. Continue without saving?'), the overlapping full-version string 製品版をダウンロードします。 carried the game title instead of its meaning, and two siblings were unified to the same wording (longest line 49 -> 36 cells). Dialogue, story, mission-title, UI-label, font and geometry text are unchanged from v4.5. Full ledger: docs/pl/PL_NONDIALOGUE_AUDIT_2026-10-26.md.
